core: Urea cycle arginine and citrulline synthesis
name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis with ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency
rationale: All members concern urea-cycle synthesis of citrulline/arginine; the OTC deficiency variants separate it from neighbours built on other urea-cycle enzyme defects or ammonium/ornithine handling.

name: Genotoxic DNA damage response with end joining and ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover responses to DNA-damaging drugs, fork reversal, R-loops and break repair; NHEJ, HR/NHEJ choice and poly-ADP-ribosylation distinguish it from checkpoint- and BRCA-centred neighbours.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling with cancer mutants and RUNX3
rationale: All members are TGF-beta/activin/BMP/AMH receptor-SMAD signaling or its regulators; cancer-associated TGFBR/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 tumour-suppressor targets separate it from ligand-sequestration and BTM-based neighbours.

name: Sarcoplasmic calcium release control of cardiac relaxation and rate
rationale: Members regulate release and clearance of sequestered calcium in muscle; the cardiac relaxation, negative contraction and heart-rate terms distinguish it from SERCA-uptake and positive-inotropy neighbours.

name: Centrosome positioning and spindle orientation in asymmetric division
rationale: Members concern MTOC nucleation/anchoring, centrosome and spindle localization and astral microtubules; spindle orientation for asymmetric division separates it from cytokinesis-ring and mitotic centrosome-recruitment neighbours.

name: Mesenchymal-to-osteoblast differentiation controlled by RUNX2 and Wnt
rationale: Members concern osteoblast/MSC proliferation and differentiation and bone development; RUNX2, Wnt antagonism and osteocyte mechanosensing distinguish it from chondrocyte-, osteoclast- and collagen-centred neighbours.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium reuptake and ryanodine-receptor release
rationale: Members regulate calcium movement between cytosol and SR/ER, including SERCA-type ATPase import, RyR release and caffeine response; it lacks the cardiac contraction/heart-rate terms of its cardiac neighbour.

name: Cardiomyocyte membrane domains and integrin-ILK adhesion signaling
rationale: Members cover caveolae/rafts, T-tubules, gap junctions, cardiomyocyte adhesion and excitability; the PINCH-ILK-parvin and integrin signaling terms distinguish it from sarcomere-contraction neighbours.

name: Natural killer cytotoxicity and its MHC class I-dependent inhibition
rationale: Members concern NK (and T) cell cytotoxicity and its regulation; KIR, MHC class Ib presentation, protection from NK killing and tolerance separate it from T-cell activation/proliferation neighbours.

name: Folate one-carbon metabolism coupled to methionine salvage
rationale: Members span folate/THF interconversion, formate and SAM/methionine metabolism; combining folate transport and catabolism with methionine salvage distinguishes it from neighbours holding only one arm.

qualifier: Wnt ligand secretion and calcium arm
name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical calcium signaling
rationale: Members concern Wnt ligand biogenesis/PORCN-dependent secretion and Wnt/Ca2+ non-canonical signaling; it lacks the planar polarity, canonical beta-catenin and vascular-barrier content of its neighbours.

name: Dendrite arborization and postsynaptic actin remodeling with filopodia control
rationale: Members regulate dendrite branching, spine and postsynaptic actin/density structure; filopodium regulation and RHOF separate it from plasticity-centred neighbours, and postsynaptic terms from EPHB/polarity neighbours.

name: Skin barrier and epidermis morphogenesis with sebaceous gland development
rationale: Members concern keratinocyte development, cornified envelope and skin barrier formation; epidermis morphogenesis and sebaceous gland development distinguish it from cornification/keratinocyte-proliferation neighbours.

name: Base excision repair and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members cover glycosylase-initiated BER (including defective OGG1/NTHL1/MUTYH/NEIL1) and long-patch gap filling plus ALKBH/MGMT reversal; the reversal and gap-filling terms separate it from ICL-repair and mismatch-repair neighbours.

name: Tyrosine, proline and glycine amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolic/catabolic terms centred on tyrosine/phenylalanine, proline and glycine/glyoxylate; the tyrosine arm distinguishes it from threonine-containing neighbours and proline/glycine from the phenylketonuria neighbour.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport with Hartnup and aminoaciduria defects
rationale: Members concern amino acid transporters at the plasma membrane and their variants; SLC6A19 Hartnup, SLC1A1 dicarboxylic aminoaciduria and SLC6A14 variants separate it from iminoglycinuria, cystinuria and peptide-transport neighbours.

name: Ventricular trabeculation and cardiomyocyte proliferation
rationale: All members concern trabecular myocardium formation and ventricular cardiomyocyte growth; it lacks the endocardial, compact myocardium and atrial terms of its neighbours.

qualifier: facultative heterochromatin, imprinting and X inactivation
name: DNA methylation-driven facultative heterochromatin, imprinting and X inactivation
rationale: Members concern DNA methylation, PRC2 and heterochromatin-based silencing including imprinting and X inactivation; it lacks the BAF/CHD remodeling and histone acetylation content of its broader chromatin neighbours.

name: Olfactory receptor-mediated smell and pheromone perception
rationale: All members concern odorant/pheromone detection by olfactory receptors; neighbours are taste-perception themes.

qualifier: RHO and CDC42 subfamilies with formins
name: RHO and CDC42 GTPase cycles with formin activation
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOD/G/J GTPase cycles and effectors; RHOA-C and formin activation separate it from RAC-, ROCK/PAK- and RND-centred neighbours.

name: Adenylate cyclase inhibition by alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz signaling
rationale: Members concern GPCR control of cyclic AMP via inhibitory Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic receptors; it lacks the PKA activation, catecholamine secretion and muscarinic/purinergic content of its neighbours.

name: Heme degradation and hepatic bilirubin clearance with hyperbilirubinemias
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole catabolism and hepatic uptake, conjugation and export of bilirubin with their inherited defects; heme catabolism and UGT1A/ABCC2 defects separate it from drug-ADME neighbours.

name: Mucosal defense against Gram-positive bacterial epithelial invasion
rationale: Members concern host defense against bacteria at mucosae, bacterial attachment/entry into epithelial cells and Gram-positive responses; Listeria-type entry and actin-based motility distinguish it from defensin, antifungal and mycobacterial neighbours.

name: Fanconi anemia cross-link repair via monoubiquitination and S-phase checkpoint
rationale: Members concern interstrand cross-link repair, monoubiquitination/deubiquitination, intra-S checkpoint and recombination resolution; the FA pathway and monoubiquitination terms separate it from fork-reversal and HR-synthesis neighbours.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation in cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy and cartilage morphogenesis; joint morphogenesis and condensation distinguish it from ossification, tendon and articular-cartilage neighbours.
